## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive (Energy, Technology, Communication); only three sectors are driving performance while the rest are negative, and leadership is narrow (Top 5 skewed to Technology). Confirmations: weak sector breadth and concentrated leadership support a neutral, range-bound market.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy lead: CVX (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +5.83%) ABOVE TREND and MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND. Technology also leading on headline movers: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND and ADBE (1W: +8.08% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Materials weak: FCX (1W: -12.81% | 1M: -4.04%) BELOW TREND and PPG (1W: -13.44% | 1M: -14.80%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples and Healthcare are also lagging: EL (1W: -15.30% | 1M: -22.24%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -10.40%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +12.63%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +10.83% | 1M: -1.00%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology-heavy).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ASML (1W: -10.88% | 1M: -3.33%) BELOW TREND, CRH (1W: -11.00% | 1M: -13.15%) BELOW TREND, MNST (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -7.16%) BELOW TREND, UPS (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -11.10%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -12.77% | 1M: +9.26%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in Materials/Industrials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Highest 1W momentum: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +12.63%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +10.83% | 1M: -1.00%) RECOVERY. Major divergence present (several large caps with 1W ≠ 1M) — treat momentum as tactical, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but positive on momentum; NVDA (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +2.08%) ABOVE TREND coexists with AAPL (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: +4.13% | 1M: -1.04%) RECOVERY. Sector is one of only three positive sectors this week; breadth narrow so risks remain.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials weak this week (sector 1W: -2.56%); JPM (1W: -3.60% | 1M: -8.76%) BELOW TREND and V (1W: -0.87% | 1M: -3.62%) BELOW TREND, while MA (1W: +0.99% | 1M: -5.63%) RECOVERY shows isolated strength. Overall Financials are not leading and detract from broad risk advance.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare under pressure (1W: -4.24%); LLY (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -10.40%) BELOW TREND, JNJ (1W: -3.23% | 1M: +3.07%) CORRECTION and UNH (1W: -2.32% | 1M: +3.83%) CORRECTION show mixed, defensive characteristics but weakening near-term.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Technology momentum names and resilient Energy exposure given current breadth (INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +5.83%) ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to weak Materials and Staples where multiple large names are BELOW TREND; monitor major-cap divergences (AAPL, GOOGL, JPM) for trend confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +8.08% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +2.08%) ABOVE TREND — watch for follow-through. BEARISH: ASML (1W: -10.88% | 1M: -3.33%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -10.40%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (sector positive; CVX ABOVE TREND, MPC ABOVE TREND) and Technology (headline momentum concentrated). BEARISH: Materials and Consumer Staples (sector weakness and multiple BELOW TREND large caps); watch for further dispersion.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +2.08%) ABOVE TREND — key resistance break would signal broader tech pickup. AAPL (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND — sustained backtest failure would increase downside risk. CVX (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +5.83%) ABOVE TREND — hold above recent breakout to confirm Energy leadership. JPM (1W: -3.60% | 1M: -8.76%) BELOW TREND — reclaiming near-term support would be required to re-engage Financials.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
INTU (+65): Strong Q2, dividend hike, Anthropic AI deal — INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed by price. PFE (+75): China obesity nod and cancer wins — PFE (1W: -2.17% | 1M: +1.01%) CORRECTION, bullish news but price showing short-term distribution that merits watching.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (-55): Rocatinlimab halt concerns — LLY (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -10.40%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed by price. BA (-50): Space/launch headwinds flagged — BA (1W: +1.57% | 1M: -2.05%) RECOVERY, bearish headlines but price showing short-term rebound (divergence).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +2.08%) ABOVE TREND and CVX (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +5.83%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow, tech-heavy leadership and multiple large-cap divergences (AAPL, GOOGL, JPM) plus sentiment/price mismatches (PFE positive news but CORRECTION) — monitor for confirmation.
